title: Bar
question: Aligned bars make category magnitudes easy to compare; the value axis includes zero.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Line
question: Connected observations show change over ordered numeric or date values; gaps must be explicit in the source.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Scatter
question: Point positions show association between two numeric measures; association does not establish causation.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Stacked Bar
question: Segments show absolute contributions to a total; middle segments are harder to compare across groups.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Heatmap
question: Cell color reveals patterns across two categories; use the values and table for exact comparisons.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Grouped Bar
question: Side-by-side bars compare named series within categories on a common zero baseline and unit.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Multi Line
question: Separate lines compare series across the same ordered x values and unit; missing values are not interpolated.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Area
question: A zero-baseline filled area shows the magnitude of a nonnegative measure over ordered observations.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Histogram
question: Explicit bins show the distribution of raw observations; bin choice affects the apparent shape.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Box
question: Boxes summarize raw sample distributions using linear-interpolated quartiles and Tukey 1.5-IQR whiskers; dots show outliers, not confidence intervals.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Ecdf
question: The empirical cumulative distribution shows the observed fraction at or below each value without selecting histogram bins.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Range
question: Supplied interval endpoints and optional estimates expose uncertainty or spread; their statistical meaning must be stated in the limits.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Dumbbell
question: Linked points preserve the before/after pairing within each category without implying a time series.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Waterfall
question: Signed contributions explain how a starting total changes; contributions must reconcile with any supplied final total.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Timeline
question: Intervals show supplied start/end positions or dates, including overlap; task counts never determine duration.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.

title: Pareto
question: Descending nonnegative contributions and an explicitly labelled cumulative-share line show concentration; the two scales are kept distinct.
limitations: Synthetic chart fixtures. No benchmark, confidence claim or real project schedule.
